Definition
[Compatibility conditions, admissible triple] 1. ch3:3.2.3-def-1\group Method of Characteristics A triple $(p^0,z^0,x^0)$ with $x_n^0=0$ is admissible if \[ z^0=g(x^0),\qquad p_i^0=g_{x_i}(x^0)\ (i<n),\qquad F(p^0,z^0,x^0)=0. \]
